description_en: Calls a Tongyi Xiaomi CCAI conversation analysis AIO application to retrieve conversation summaries, key information extraction results, quality inspection results, and conversation analysis results. The application supports HTTP calls to complete customer responses. Both standard HTTP and HTTP SSE protocols are available. Choose the protocol that best suits your needs
description_zh: 支持调用通义晓蜜CCAI-对话分析AIO应用获取对话摘要、关键信息抽取、质检结果、对话分析结果，应用调用支持 HTTP 调用来完成客户的响应，目前提供普通 HTTP 和 HTTP SSE 两种协议，您可根据自己的需求自行选择
kebab_example: aliyun contactcenterai run-completion --workspace-id llm-ik000000RVYCKzt --app-id 097d65c9c7004f8dad2b454850ac232b --dialogue '{"Sentences":[{"Role":"user","Text":"查询北京天气","ChatId":"ae2483e01a8446aa859925947fcf4d8e"}],"SessionId":"d25zc9c7004f8dad2b454d"}' --fields '[{"Desc":"用户来电咨询的原因分类，主要有投诉、咨询、政策建议等。","Code":"phoneNumber","EnumValues":[{"Desc":"客户有新的需求/新的场景，客服跟进沟通需求细节","EnumValue":"新业务拓展"}],"Name":"来电原因类型"}]' --model-code tyxmTurbo --service-inspection '{"InspectionContents":[{"Content":"客服在服务客户过程中，基于已有的服务标准是否存在过度承诺的行为，如：最快到货时间是12小时，无法给客户承诺更快的到货时间。","Title":"客服是否过度承诺"}],"InspectionIntroduction":"请检测客服是否存在服务不当的行为，包括：过度承诺、故意套取客户隐私信息等","SceneIntroduction":"保险销售场景"}' --stream false --template-ids 10375 --variables variableValue=张三 variableCode=name --response-format-type jsonObject --region cn-hangzhou
name: RunCompletion
